timeline.summary: Ramses Overdark visits Elsdragon's camp to ensure he will not interfere; Marhault says he acts only on the Emperor's word.
timeline.quote: Marhault simply stated he would only act if the Emperor bade him to.

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ramses lures Jorgan Hage into a trap and corrupts him with black magic.
timeline.quote: Ramses then lured Hage into a trap, ambushing him and corrupting him with black magic

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ramses Overdark takes control of the kentsu after being spared by Bolas.
timeline.quote: Ramses Overdark then assumed control of the kentsu after being spared by Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Overdark to reclaim the rebellious Edemi Islands; Overdark plots to kill Tetsuo, but his minions and serpent generator are defeated.
timeline.quote: When the Edemi Islands rebelled against the empire, Bolas first sent Overdark to reclaim them.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Madara-Edemi War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark disobeys Bolas's orders, sending agents to the islands, including Halfdane and a forged decree to bring Orca.
timeline.quote: But Overdark disobeyed the direct orders of the emperor and sent agents to the islands anyway.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Sidelined". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orca turns on the kentsu and Hage decapitates Elsdragon, usurping the title of general as Overdark's minion.
timeline.quote: Hage decapitated Elsdragon and usurped the title of general

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Sidelined". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas, impressed by his ambition, names Overdark imperial regent.
timeline.quote: Bolas then awarded Overdark with the title of imperial regent.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Imperial Regent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo renounces his title as imperial champion and swears vengeance on Overdark.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo had renounced his title of imperial champion

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Imperial Regent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolo Meha destroys Overdark's keep at Tetsuo's order, killing Zalgadib.
timeline.quote: Kolo Meha was ordered to destroy the keep by Tetsuo Umezawa, killing Zalgadib.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Imperial Regent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo fights his way to the Imperial Shrine, kills Overdark and absorbs his powers.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo killed Overdark and absorbed his powers to use them against Bolas.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Imperial Regent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis and punishes Umezawa and Overdark, placing Umezawa under Elsdragon and keeping Overdark out of the campaign.
timeline.quote: He charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elsdragon, Tetsuo and Overdark meet on the Meditation Plane and invoke the emperor, who destroys the Greater Realm of Preservation just by blinking.
timeline.quote: Elsdragon and Tetsuo meet Overdark on the Meditation Plane and the three of them invoke the emperor, who destroys the Realm just by blinking.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark sends Lady Orca to help; she destroys the Akron and Caleria's wall, then turns on the Kentsu.
timeline.quote: The Kentsu soldiers cheer, but then Orca turns around and attacks them!

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark reveals that he controls Hage, who decapitates Elsdragon and seizes the title of highest general of the Kentsu.
timeline.quote: Overdark reveals that he controls Hage, and orders the Ærathi to decapitate Elsdragon and seize the title of highest general of the Kentsu.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals himself as Nicol Bolas and makes Overdark imperial regent.
timeline.quote: He makes Overdark the imperial regent

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3607 AR, Xira resurfaces as a Eumidian master assassin working for Ramses Overdark and is sent to kill Lady Caleria.
timeline.quote: Xira was sent to assassinate the leader of the rebellion, Lady Caleria .

citation.text: "Xira Arien", section "Eumidian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Edemi Islands rebel and the emperor orders Overdark to quell the uprising; Overdark hopes Tetsuo will die in the conflict.
timeline.quote: The emperor orders his imperial assassin Ramses Overdark to quell the uprising.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark sends Lady Orca to attack Kusho in Umezawa's crest and orders Xira Arien to lure Tetsuo to the Edemis.
timeline.quote: orders the assassin Xira Arien to lure Tetsuo to the Edemis.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark meets Elsdragon, who says the Kentsu will not interfere unless the emperor orders it.
timeline.quote: Elsdragon replies that he will not interfere unless told to do so by the emperor.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jorgan Hage ambushes Overdark for revenge, but Overdark subdues him and infuses him with black mana, making him a minion.
timeline.quote: Overdark easily subdues him, however, and infuses Hage with black mana, making him the assassin's minion without his knowledge.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark summons Lady Orca again; she attacks Caleria's castle and is defeated by Tetsuo, who is left drained.
timeline.quote: The giantess attacks Lady Caleria's castle but is defeated by Tetsuo.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo breaks out of prison, frees Tor and challenges Caleria to a duel as Overdark activates the Serpent Generator.
timeline.quote: Then Overdark activates the artifact Xira hid for him- a Serpent Generator .

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor, furious at Overdark's failure, gives the task of culling the rebellion to Elsdragon and Hage.
timeline.quote: The emperor is furious about the assassin's failure.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark lures Tetsuo to the Edemis by having Xira Arien infect Kei with her larva.
timeline.quote: He lured Tetsuo to the Edemis by having Xira Arien place her larva in Kei Takahashi

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "First journey to the Edemis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo defeats Orca and Arien and destroys Overdark's serpent generator.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo defeated Orca and Arien and destroyed Overdark's trump card, a serpent generator .

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "First journey to the Edemis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark has Elsdragon killed and is made regent; Tetsuo, finding Ayesha poisoned, Tor wounded and Kei killed, renounces his title and swears vengeance.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo renounced his title of champion and swore vengeance.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Second journey to the Edemis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo kills Overdark in single combat and absorbs his powers, aided by Meha's destruction of Overdark's Keep.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo managed to kill Overdark and absorb his powers.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Champion against emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Argenti Hage learns Ayesha became the forest's avatar and killed all Kentsu there; Overdark rescues Hage.
timeline.quote: Just before he is about to die, Hage is saved by Overdark

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Meha and the kittens destroy Kentsu forces sent to lure Tetsuo; Bolas robs Overdark of his body in punishment.
timeline.quote: Bolas robs Overdark of the use of his body

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wasitora routs the legion sent to level Umezawa Manor.
timeline.quote: that group is intercepted and routed by Wasitora

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Meha levels Overdark's keep and becomes a seventh circle master, cutting Overdark off from his mana.
timeline.quote: Overdark is now cut off from his main mana source.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo kills Overdark in the Imperial Shrine after Bolas's spell is deflected onto him.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo strikes first and kills Overdark.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo flees into the realm, reveals his plan and cleaves Bolas's spirit in half before escaping to Madara as the realm's boundaries collapse.
timeline.quote: The champion cleaved the elder dragon's spirit in half and narrowly escaped to Madara

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Madaran refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Halfdane plants black mana crystals to poison Kusho's mages; Gosta falls ill.
timeline.quote: Gosta himself had fallen seriously ill.

citation.text: "Kusho", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Madara-Edemi War Bolas makes Ramses Overdark imperial regent as Overdark replaces other officers.
timeline.quote: Bolas then made a new system with only one placeholder for the emperor

citation.text: "Madara", section "History of Madara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa kills Overdark and exiles Bolas; the empire falls into chaos.
timeline.quote: former champion Tetsuo Umezawa killed Overdark and exiled Bolas

citation.text: "Madara", section "History of Madara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark launches an aggressive campaign against the Edemi Islands with the Emperor's approval.
timeline.quote: launched an aggressive campaign against the islands

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark sends Xira Arien to target Umezawa, who is drawn in after defending Sekana from Wasitora.
timeline.quote: Overdark dispatching his minion, the eumidian Xira Arien

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Emperor orders Elsdragon to invade the Edemis; Hage assassinates Elsdragon and seizes command.
timeline.quote: Hage, now under Overdark’s control, took advantage of the chaos to assassinate Elsdragon

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umezawa renounces his title and vows to overthrow Overdark and the Emperor; the Emperor paralyzes Overdark.
timeline.quote: renounced his title and vowed to overthrow both Overdark and the Emperor

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umezawa kills Xira Arien and Jorgan Hage, storms the Imperial Shrine and decapitates Overdark, absorbing his power.
timeline.quote: Umezawa decapitated the assassin and absorbed his magical power

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
